description: Point check of one pair, about 1-3 KB: a and b are each a supplement (name or canonical_id) or a medication (generic name; salt forms merged, brand names not matched). Supplement + supplement uses Aviado's verified pairs only (components and classes included); supplement + medication uses FDA drug-label rows only; two medications are not covered (no_match). Returns verdict {found, severity, direction, summary, recommendation, recorded_for, evidence_level, sources} and coverage (level none/sparse/moderate/broad). found:false is NOT a safety answer: an empty result is not evidence that there is no interaction, so read coverage.note and say so. Check status first: needs_confirmation / no_match means the input did not resolve, data is null and next_step says how to retry.

a.description: First supplement (name or canonical id) or medication (generic name)

b.description: Second supplement (name or canonical id) or medication (generic name)
